articles.summary: Stewart Information Services Corporation (NYSE: STC) announced today it will hold a conference call to discuss third quarter 2026 earnings at 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time on Thursday, October 22, 2026. The call will follow the company’s release of earnings after the close of trading on Wednesday, October 21. Individuals wishing to participate can dial (833) 419-0865 (USA) and (785) 838-9333 (International) – access code STCQ326. The conference call replay will be available from 11 a.m. Eastern Time on October 22, 2026, until midnight on October 29, 2026, by dialing (800) 839-5241 (USA) or (402) 220-2698 (International). Additionally, participants can listen to the conference call through STC’s Investor Relations website at https://investors.stewart.com/news-and-events/events/default.aspx . About Stewart Stewart (NYSE-STC) is a global real estate services company, offering products and services through our direct operations, network of Stewart Trusted Providers™ and family of companies. articles.summary: Total revenues of $900.7 million (GAAP and adjusted basis) compared to $796.9 million ($791.3 million on an adjusted basis) in the prior year quarter Net income of $30.3 million ($41.2 million on an adjusted basis) compared to net income of $44.3 million ($46.7 million on an adjusted basis) in the prior year quarter Diluted EPS of $0.98 ($1.33 on an adjusted basis) compared to prior year quarter diluted EPS of $1.55 ($1.64 on an adjusted basis) Stewart Information Services Corporation (NYSE: STC) today reported net income attributable to Stewart of $30.3 million ($0.98 per diluted share) for the third quarter 2026, compared to net income attributable to Stewart of $44.3 million ($1.55 per diluted share) for the third quarter 2025. On an adjusted basis, net income for the third quarter 2026 was $41.2 million ($1.33 per diluted share) compared to net income of $46.7 million ($1.64 per diluted share) in the third quarter 2025.
